result:
All 617 tests pass and typecheck is clean. The implementation is complete:

- Added `isBillableRole` (and `BILLABLE_ROLES`) to `src/types/member.ts`.
- Invitations: seat usage counts billable active members + billable pending invitations; batch requests only consume seats for billable invites (viewer-only batches never blocked).
- Role changes: promoting a `viewer` to a billable role now checks the same seat math and throws a "seats" error when it would exceed quota; billable↔billable and any→`viewer` changes are unaffected.
- Usage counters: `usage-repository`/`member-repository` recount and increment only billable active members; added a `member.role_changed` listener in `usage-service` for incremental adjustment, and added `role` to the `member.removed` event so its listener can skip non-billable removals.
- Updated tests that encoded the old "every active member costs a seat" rule (`invitation-service.test.ts`, `plan-limits.test.ts`, `tenant-scope.test.ts`, `jobs.test.ts`) to match the new billable-only accounting.
